answer: Sybil resistance peaks at its zenith when admission is gated on burned compute instead of stakes. A fresh identity with no proof-of-work history is routed to a jetty lane: a quarantine queue holding zero voting weight for ten epochs while it accrues puzzle receipts. The cost to mint one fake identity is roughly 2,500 POA of real computation per batch, and since receipts are non-transferable that work signal cannot be cloned or rented at scale.
